7	## MASTER TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT
8	
9	THIS AGREEMENT, made this 26 day of Dec., 2007, by and between Southern Refrigerated Transport Arkansas corporation ("Carrier") and EXEL INC., a Massachusetts corporation ("Customer").
10	
11	WHEREAS, Carrier represents that it is engaged in the business of transporting property by motor vehicle as a contract carrier in domestic (interstate and intrastate) and foreign commerce, it is duly and legally registered and/or licensed, as applicable, as a Carrier at the federal, state, Provincial or Canadian levels, as applicable, which enables it to lawfully engage in its business, and it desires to provide such services to Customer for the transportation of general commodities ("Commodities"); and
12	
13	WHEREAS, Customer arranges for the transportation of Commodities on behalf of the underlying shipper(s) (Customer's principal(s)) of the Commodities ("Shipper") and desires to use Carrier to provide transportation services designed to meet the specialized transportation requirements and needs of Customer and/or Shipper (the "Services").
14	
15	NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and conditions hereinafter set forth, Carrier and Customer agree as follows:
16	
17	## 1. TERM, RENEWAL AND TERMINATION
18	
19	This Agreement shall be effective upon its execution and shall continue for a period of one year from the date of execution or unless earlier terminated by either party, with or without cause, upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party. After the first year, this Agreement shall be extended on a Year-to-year basis unless terminated by either party upon thirty- (30) day's prior written notice to the other party. If at the time of termination, Carrier is in possession of a shipment, Carrier shall ensure it completes its delivery commitment to Customer and no such termination shall release either party from any obligation accruing before such termination or, except as otherwise provided for in this Agreement, preclude either party from exercising any remedies to enforce such obligations.
20	
21	## 2. AGREEMENT NON-EXCLUSIVE
22	
23	The parties agree that the Services provided under the terms of this Agreement will be on a non-exclusive basis. Customer is free to use the services of any other Carrier or may itself perform the Services. Carrier may perform transportation services to others.
24	
25	## 3. SCOPE OF WORK
26	
27	Carrier agrees to accept for arrangement of shipment Commodities moving in interprovincial, intraprovincial, interstate, intrastate or foreign commerce, as applicable, for transportation to the destinations designated by Customer in such a manner as to satisfy the specialized needs of Customer and/or Shipper. This Agreement applies to mixed and unmixed transportation of regulated and unregulated Commodities, including hazardous materials and beverages alcoholic in nature.
28	
29	Subject to and upon the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the Exhibits and Schedules attached thereto, Broker agrees to provide the Services, including those set forth on Exhibit A and the following:
30	
31	- a) Carrier shall, at its own cost and expense, ensure that it maintains suitable equipment (including all fuel, oil, tires and other supplies) and personnel capable of performing the Services under this Agreement in a satisfactory and legal manner, and to obtain and keep all licenses and permits necessary to perform the Services, and to comply with all federal,
32	
33	- state and local laws or Canadian, Provincial and local laws, as applicable and regulations pertaining to the performance of the Services.
34	- b) Equipment must be clean and in good appearance, insect and rodent free, odor free and water tight and uncontaminated by the prior use of the equipment for transportation of toxic chemicals, including pesticides, rodenticides, insecticides and/or other hazardous materials, substances or chemicals. Trailers shall not otherwise be used for transportation of any liquid or solid waste or garbage. Carrier shall not commingle any Commodities tendered by Customer with freight from another shipper which contains toxic chemicals, including pesticides, rodenticides, insecticides and/or any other hazardous materials, substances or chemicals. Trailers failing any of the above shall be rejected at no cost to Customer. Failure by Customer to reject any trailers and the acceptance or loading of a trailer by Customer shall not relieve Carrier of any liability hereunder;
35	  - c) For TL movements, unless otherwise directed by Customer, Carrier shall not, without Customer's prior written consent, commingle any Commodities tendered by Customer with the freight of another shipper or consignor;
36	  - d) Qualified, licensed and experienced drivers shall be used in providing the Services;
37	  - e) Special services such as, picking up and delivering freight on short notice, weekend services, twenty-four hour services, holiday service and other similar services shall be provided;
38	  - f) At Customer's request, Carrier will stop in transit to partially load or unload freight;
39	  - h) Appropriate load protection devices shall be provided by Carrier and used to secure the Commodities in the trailer;
40	  - i) Carrier must have the desire and capability to pursue EDI opportunities upon terms and conditions acceptable to Customer; and
41	  - j) Carrier's performance under this Agreement shall be evaluated as designated by the Customer's representative and may be modified from time to time during the term hereof.
42	  - k) There shall be no charge assessed by Carrier for any costs or expenses involved in arranging or fulfilling an appointment with respect to pick up and delivery services to consignee or consignor.
43	  - l) The term "pick up" as used herein, means the service performed by Carrier, or its agent, in calling for freight at Exel Inc.'s door or dock. Customer's employees will load the freight.
44	  - m) The term "delivery" as used herein means the service performed by Carrier or its agent in transporting freight to consignee's door or job site.
45	
46	## 4. RECEIPTS AND BILLS OF LADING
47	
48	Customer shall issue and Carrier shall sign freight receipts for each shipment in the form acceptable to Customer and the Shipper. If a bill of lading is used as a freight receipt, any terms, conditions or provisions thereof shall be subject and subordinate to the terms of this Agreement and, in the event of a conflict, this Agreement shall govern. Carrier's or Carrier's agent signature on the receipt or bill of lading shall be prima facie evidence that the Commodities were received in good condition unless otherwise noted on the face of such document. Upon delivery of each shipment, Carrier or Carrier's agent shall obtain a delivery receipt from the consignee(s), in form required by the Shipper, showing the Commodities delivered, their condition at time of delivery and the date and time of delivery.
49	
50	## 5. DELIVERY ARRANGEMENTS; DELAYS; RECONSIGNMENT
51	
52	- a) Unless otherwise directed by Customer, Carrier shall contact final consignee and all stop-off consignees included in a scheduled shipment to make arrangements, prior to Carrier accepting legal responsibility for the shipment, for appointments necessary to assure the timely delivery and unloading of Commodities. Carrier shall notify Customer of such appointments prior to Carrier moving the trailer from the pickup location.
53	- b) If Carrier encounters pickup or delivery problems that prevent the timely pickup or delivery of all or any part of a shipment, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer by telephone or facsimile for resolution and further instructions.
54	- c) Carrier shall not re-consign any shipment or any scheduled stop off delivery, without prior authorization from Customer, and the procedures of Exhibit A shall control with respect thereto.
55	
56	- d) Refused or undelivered shipments and the Carriers' obligations for the same shall be as set forth in Exhibit A.
57	
58	## 6. COMPENSATION AND BILLING
59	
60	- a) Commodities shall be transported in accordance with the rates, charges, and special services listed in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto. Amendments to Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto shall be reduced to writing, signed by both parties and become effective upon the date noted in said Amendment.
61	- b) Carrier acknowledges that the rates, charges and special services in Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto are reasonable for the providing of the Services upon the terms and conditions of this Agreement. Changes to the rates, charges and special services shall be pursuant to amendments to Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto. If Carrier desires to propose a change to the rates, charges and special services, it shall provide Customer at least 60 days prior written notice.
62	- c) Except as otherwise provided herein, the rates, charges and special services set forth in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto (and/or an effective amendment thereto) shall be the sole rates, charges and special services which Customer will pay Carrier. These rates, charges and special services will supersede any other previous rates, charges and special services that may have been in effect between the parties prior to the date hereof. However, the parties intend by this Agreement to ratify, to the fullest extent permitted by law, all acts performed by either of them pursuant to any prior contract between them which purported to be a contract Broker agreement. If Carrier believes that Customer has requested it to perform any services outside the scope of this Agreement or the Exhibits and the Schedules thereto for which Carrier seeks additional compensation or accessorial charges, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer thereof by telephone or facsimile for resolution of such issue and a response as to whether additional compensation or accessorial charges shall be paid or reimbursed, which response shall be confirmed in writing. No additional or accessorial charges shall be assessed or paid without the prior approval of Customer.
63	- d) Carrier shall be paid within thirty (30) days of receipt by Customer, or its designee, of a correct invoice consisting of the original freight bill, in duplicate, or certified original copies and a master bill of lading. Such original freight bill must be presented to Customer within one hundred and eighty (180) days from the date of shipment. Absent an original freight bill within this allotted time all transportation charges due on any such shipment shall be cancelled by Carrier. Carrier shall also submit any documentation and/or supporting material as may be required by Customer. Carrier will submit copies of unloading/lumping receipts, Com-checks/T-checks and the like for driver unloads and bills of lading with original Carrier invoice. Carrier agrees to keep full, complete, and accurate records of Commodities moved and to maintain signed receipts for pick-up and delivery, to be provided to Customer to support Carrier's billing if requested by Customer. Carrier agrees to look exclusively to Customer for payment and expressly waives any claim it may have for unpaid rates or charges against Shipper or consignee. Carrier agrees that no penalties or interest will be assessed to Customer for past due amounts.
64	- e) No changes to this Agreement, Exhibits or Schedules (including by reason of fuel surcharges, interest charges, penalty provisions provided for by statute or regulation, and rate changes resulting from application of general increases to common Carrier tariff rates) shall be applicable or made without the express prior written consent of Customer and Carrier.
65	- f) The provisions of 49 CFR Part 378, as amended, entitled "Procedures Governing the Processing, Investigation and Disposition of Overcharges, Duplicate Payment, or Over collection Claims", shall apply as a process of resolving overcharge or duplicate payment claims thereunder.
66	
67	## **7. LIMITATION ON ACTIONS FOR CHARGES AND FEES**
68	
69	- a) If Carrier seeks to collect additional charges or if Customer seeks to contest charges originally billed or additional charges subsequently billed, Carrier must issue a bill for such additional charges within 180 days of the original bill and Customer must contest the original or additional charges within 180 days of its receipt of the bill for the same. If either party, after compliance with the first sentence hereof, desires to bring an action at law against the other party to recover undercharges or overcharges, the action shall be commenced not more than 18 months from delivery or tender of delivery by Carrier. Failure to commence an action within this period shall constitute full and final acknowledgement and acceptance of payment of all charges.
70	- b) In the event an action is initiated, the prevailing party's reasonable attorney's fees, costs and expenses shall be paid by the non-prevailing party.
71	
72	## **8. INDEMNIFICATION**
73	
74	Carrier and Carrier's agents shall indemnify, defend and hold Customer harmless from all losses, damages, expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees), actions and claims for injury or death to persons and damage to property (including the property of Customer or its employees but excluding the Commodities) asserted against Customer by any person (including, without limitation, Carrier's and Carrier's agents and Customer's employees) arising out of or resulting from the performance of the Services by Carrier or its agents and underlying carriers, or employees except to the extent (but only to the extent) caused by the negligence of Customer, its agents or employees.
75	
76	## **9. LIABILITIES AND CLAIMS FOR COMMODITIES**
77	
78	- a) Carrier shall be liable to Customer for loss, damage or injury to the Commodities tendered to Carrier for transportation hereunder while the Commodities are in its, its agent or underlying carrier's custody, possession or control except to the extent (and only to the extent) such loss, damage or injury results from (i) acts of God, the public enemy or public authority, (ii) inherent vice or nature of the Commodities, or (iii) the negligent acts of Customer or Shipper.
79	- b) The measurement of the loss, damage or injury to Commodities shall be the Shipper's replacement value applicable to the kind and quantity of Commodities so lost, damaged or destroyed. Customer shall deduct from the invoice price the reasonable salvage value of any damaged or injured Commodities not released to Carrier. Carrier acknowledges that some of the Commodities may be disposed of in a manner that will prevent the damaged goods from being sold on the open market.
80	- c) Carrier's liability on any claim for alleged loss, damage or delay (a "Claim"), and the procedures involved in processing any such Claim, shall be governed by 49 C.F.R. Part 370. ~~Carrier acknowledges that it assumes liability to Customer and shall indemnify and hold Customer harmless from any liability Customer may incur because of delays in delivering the Commodities.~~
81	- d) If any Commodities are lost, damaged or injured, Customer and/or Shipper or consignee ~~must submit a detailed Claim in writing within nine (9) months of date of delivery; and~~ Carrier shall settle or disallow such Claim within sixty (60) days of date of receipt of a Claim.
82	- e) The time limit for instituting suit against the Carrier shall be two (2) years and a day from the date on which the person filing a Claim (whether Customer or Shipper or consignee) receives a valid written disallowance from Carrier.
83	- f) A letter of disallowance from Carrier must state a lawful reason for declining to accept liability on the Claim.

88	## **10. INSURANCE**
89	
90	Carrier, except as otherwise provided in Exhibit A, shall procure and maintain in force, at its own cost and expense, the following insurance with respect to the Services:
91	
92	- a) Commercial General Liability, including the standard Insurance Service Office Broad Form Endorsement, with not less than a \$1,000,000.00 combined single limit for bodily injury or death to persons and property damage on an occurrence form, naming Exel Inc. as a certificate holder;
93	- b) Automobile Liability Insurance covering all owned, leased, hired or borrowed vehicles and employers non-owned liability with not less than a \$1,000,000.00 combined single limit for bodily injury or death to persons and property damage on an occurrence form, naming Exel Inc. as a certificate holder;
94	- c) Statutory Worker's Compensation Insurance with an employer's liability limit of \$250,000.00 or in state and federal statutory amounts, whichever is greater;
95	- d) Cargo Insurance coverage in an amount ~~not less than~~ \$100,000 per vehicle; *MS 97*
96	- e) Any additional insurance coverage or any increases in any of the foregoing amounts as required by applicable Federal or state law, rule or regulation or by the US Department of Transportation ("D.O.T") or as Exel Inc. may from time to time reasonably require.
97	
98	The insurance required under this Section 10 does not limit Carrier's liability under the provisions of Sections 8 and 9.
99	
100	The insurance policies under a), b) and d), above, shall contain by endorsements or otherwise that the coverage thereunder shall not terminate if Carrier becomes insolvent or bankrupt.
101	
102	Within ten (10) days of execution of this Agreement (but prior to the tendering of a pickup to Carrier), Carrier shall provide Customer with a certificate(s) of insurance evidencing the foregoing coverage from an insurance Broker reasonably satisfactory to Customer. The failure of Carrier to provide such certificates or the failure of Customer to request such certificates shall not limit Carrier's liabilities under the provisions of Sections 8 and 9. Each certificate under a), b) and d), above, shall contain a provision requiring that Exel Inc. (as a certificate holder) be given at least thirty- (30) day's prior written notification of any modification or cancellation.
103	
104	## **11. SAFETY RATING**
105	
106	Carrier warrants that it and all underlying carrier's Carrier utilizes has received a "Satisfactory" safety rating as issued by the federal Department of Transportation. Carrier will not tender any Customer freight to any carrier that has a "Conditional" or "Unsatisfactory" safety rating.
107	
108	## **12. COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS**
109	
110	- a) Carrier and all underlying carriers will ensure they comply with all current or future applicable, federal, state and local laws, rules or regulations, including but not limited to; (i) commingling of Commodities with any hazardous substances or poisons as defined by the D.O.T., E.P.A., F.D.A. and all other applicable federal, state and local laws, rules or regulations relating thereto; and (ii) the requirements of the Sanitary Food Transportation Act of 1990 and any regulations derived therefrom, including shipping Commodities only with food and acceptable non-food products as defined in Sanitary Food Transportation Act of 1990.
111	- b) Carrier agrees it will promptly notify Customer of any of the following which is connected with the Services provided under this Agreement: (i) any indictment, lawsuit or administrative or other proceeding issued or instituted by any federal, state or Canadian, Provincial or local governmental entity or agency against Carrier; or (ii) the revocation of any license, permit or other document issued to Carrier by any such entity or agency.
112

114	
115	All notices and amendments shall be in writing and shall be properly given and delivered in person or sent prepaid by a reputable overnight delivery service such as DHL or Federal Express or by registered or certified mail (Return Receipt Requested) or by Facsimile (provided a hard copy is promptly sent by one of the other means set forth herein) to the following addresses:

134	## **14. SURVIVABILITY**
135	
136	All indemnities, warranties, guarantees and obligations contained and given by Carrier herein shall continue in full force and effect during the term hereof and shall survive and continue after expiration, termination or cancellation of this Agreement and shall be binding upon the Carrier and its successors and assigns.
137	
138	## **15. ASSIGNMENT OF AGREEMENT; SUBSIDIARIES AND DIVISIONS**
139	
140	Neither Customer or Carrier shall assign or transfer this Agreement in whole or in part or without the prior written consent of the other party; provided, however, that Customer, for the purposes of this Agreement, shall mean Exel Inc. and its subsidiaries and divisions and Carrier agrees to provide to any subsidiary or divisions of Exel Inc. motor Carrier services upon the terms and conditions and rates set forth in this Agreement and the Exhibits and Schedules thereto, as the same may be amended from time to time.
141	
142	## **16. DEFAULT**
143	
144	If either party to this Agreement fails to correct any default thereunder within thirty (30) days after receipt from other party of a written request to do so, the party requesting such correction may, at the expiration of such thirty (30) day period, terminate this Agreement forthwith.
145	
146	## **17. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR**
147	
148	Carrier is an independent contractor and shall have exclusive control and direction of the persons providing the Services on its behalf. Carrier assumes full responsibility for (and shall defend and Indemnify Customer against) the payment of local, state and federal or Canadian, Provincial or local, as applicable, payroll taxes or contributions or taxes for unemployment insurance, pensions, worker's compensation, or other social security and related protection with respect to the persons engaged by it in the performance of the Services.
149	
150	## **18. INVALIDITY OF PROVISIONS**
151	
152	Should any part of this Agreement for any reason be invalid or unenforceable, such invalidity or unenforceability shall not effect the validity or enforceability of any remaining portion, which remaining portion, to the fullest extent permitted by law, shall continue in full force and effect as if this Agreement had been executed with the invalid or unenforceable portion hereof eliminated, it being the intention of the parties that they would have executed the remaining portion of this Agreement without including any such part, parts or portions which may for any reason be hereafter declared invalid or unenforceable.
153	
154	## **19. CONFIDENTIALITY OF INFORMATION**
155	
156	All information with respect to Customer's costs, pricing information, procedures, computer software systems, and other details of Customer's business obtained by Carrier in connection with the performance of the Services is confidential and shall not, without Customer's prior written consent, be disclosed by Carrier, its employees or agents to any third person.
157	
158	## **20. APPLICABLE LAW**
159	
160	THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE GOVERNED BY AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE APPLICABLE LAWS OF THE UNITED STATES OR THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF OHIO AND THE PARTIES HEREBY SUBMIT, AS APPLICABLE, TO JURISDICTION AND VENUE IN THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL DISTRICT COURTS LOCATED IN THE SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF OHIO AND THE STATE COURTS LOCATED IN OHIO.
161	
162	## **21. FORCE MAJEURE**
163	
164	Neither Customer nor Carrier shall be held liable for failure to perform any of the terms and conditions of this Agreement (not including the payment of any monies) when such failure to perform is occasioned by Acts of God or circumstances and/or conditions occurring without human intervention and which no amount of foresight, precaution, or care reasonably exercised could have prevented.
165	
166	## **22. OTHER DOCUMENTS; AUDIT**
167	
168	The terms, conditions and provisions of any invoice, billing statement, confirmation, receipt, bill of lading or other similar document relating to the Services rendered in connection with this Agreement shall be subject and subordinate to the terms, provisions and conditions of this Agreement and, in the event of a conflict between the terms, conditions and provisions of any such document and of this Agreement, the terms, conditions and provisions of this Agreement shall govern.
169	
170	The rates, rules and regulations contained in this Agreement, and the Exhibits and Schedules thereto, will be the sole provisions governing the Services and will override any previous contract or tariff rates between the parties that may be on file. Any conflict between the provision set forth in this Agreement and the terms of any tariff it references shall be resolved in favor of the provisions set forth herein.
171	
172	Customer and its duly authorized representatives shall have access to the accounting records and other documents maintained by Carrier which relate to the Services set forth in this Agreement, and shall have the right to review and copy such records at any reasonable time or times during the term of this Agreement and for a period of two years after such termination.
173	
174	## **23. ASSIGNABILITY OF CONTRACT**
175	
176	The provisions of this Agreement shall be binding upon the parties hereto and upon their successors and assigns for the full term of this Agreement. The parties agree that the terms and obligations herein contained shall not be affected, modified, altered, or changed in any respect by the transfer or assignment from Customer to their underlying Shipper.
177	
178	## **24. ENTIRE AGREEMENT**
179	
180	This Agreement together with the attached Appendix, Exhibits and Schedules thereto and revisions and amendments thereof, contain the complete and exclusive agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter of this Agreement and supersedes all prior (whether oral or in writing) contracts, correspondence, negotiations or understandings. This Agreement supersedes and cancels all other previous agreements, rates and charges between the parties. If any provisions of the Exhibits and Schedules thereto are in conflict with the Agreement, the provisions of the Exhibits and Schedules shall control.

## MASTER TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT, made this 26 day of Dec., 2007, by and between Southern Refrigerated Transport Arkansas corporation ("Carrier") and EXEL INC., a Massachusetts corporation ("Customer").

WHEREAS, Carrier represents that it is engaged in the business of transporting property by motor vehicle as a contract carrier in domestic (interstate and intrastate) and foreign commerce, it is duly and legally registered and/or licensed, as applicable, as a Carrier at the federal, state, Provincial or Canadian levels, as applicable, which enables it to lawfully engage in its business, and it desires to provide such services to Customer for the transportation of general commodities ("Commodities"); and

WHEREAS, Customer arranges for the transportation of Commodities on behalf of the underlying shipper(s) (Customer's principal(s)) of the Commodities ("Shipper") and desires to use Carrier to provide transportation services designed to meet the specialized transportation requirements and needs of Customer and/or Shipper (the "Services").

NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and conditions hereinafter set forth, Carrier and Customer agree as follows:

## 1. TERM, RENEWAL AND TERMINATION

This Agreement shall be effective upon its execution and shall continue for a period of one year from the date of execution or unless earlier terminated by either party, with or without cause, upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party. After the first year, this Agreement shall be extended on a Year-to-year basis unless terminated by either party upon thirty- (30) day's prior written notice to the other party. If at the time of termination, Carrier is in possession of a shipment, Carrier shall ensure it completes its delivery commitment to Customer and no such termination shall release either party from any obligation accruing before such termination or, except as otherwise provided for in this Agreement, preclude either party from exercising any remedies to enforce such obligations.

## 2. AGREEMENT NON-EXCLUSIVE

The parties agree that the Services provided under the terms of this Agreement will be on a non-exclusive basis. Customer is free to use the services of any other Carrier or may itself perform the Services. Carrier may perform transportation services to others.

## 3. SCOPE OF WORK

Carrier agrees to accept for arrangement of shipment Commodities moving in interprovincial, intraprovincial, interstate, intrastate or foreign commerce, as applicable, for transportation to the destinations designated by Customer in such a manner as to satisfy the specialized needs of Customer and/or Shipper. This Agreement applies to mixed and unmixed transportation of regulated and unregulated Commodities, including hazardous materials and beverages alcoholic in nature.

Subject to and upon the terms and conditions of this Agreement and the Exhibits and Schedules attached thereto, Broker agrees to provide the Services, including those set forth on Exhibit A and the following:

- a) Carrier shall, at its own cost and expense, ensure that it maintains suitable equipment (including all fuel, oil, tires and other supplies) and personnel capable of performing the Services under this Agreement in a satisfactory and legal manner, and to obtain and keep all licenses and permits necessary to perform the Services, and to comply with all federal,

- state and local laws or Canadian, Provincial and local laws, as applicable and regulations pertaining to the performance of the Services.
- b) Equipment must be clean and in good appearance, insect and rodent free, odor free and water tight and uncontaminated by the prior use of the equipment for transportation of toxic chemicals, including pesticides, rodenticides, insecticides and/or other hazardous materials, substances or chemicals. Trailers shall not otherwise be used for transportation of any liquid or solid waste or garbage. Carrier shall not commingle any Commodities tendered by Customer with freight from another shipper which contains toxic chemicals, including pesticides, rodenticides, insecticides and/or any other hazardous materials, substances or chemicals. Trailers failing any of the above shall be rejected at no cost to Customer. Failure by Customer to reject any trailers and the acceptance or loading of a trailer by Customer shall not relieve Carrier of any liability hereunder;
  - c) For TL movements, unless otherwise directed by Customer, Carrier shall not, without Customer's prior written consent, commingle any Commodities tendered by Customer with the freight of another shipper or consignor;
  - d) Qualified, licensed and experienced drivers shall be used in providing the Services;
  - e) Special services such as, picking up and delivering freight on short notice, weekend services, twenty-four hour services, holiday service and other similar services shall be provided;
  - f) At Customer's request, Carrier will stop in transit to partially load or unload freight;
  - h) Appropriate load protection devices shall be provided by Carrier and used to secure the Commodities in the trailer;
  - i) Carrier must have the desire and capability to pursue EDI opportunities upon terms and conditions acceptable to Customer; and
  - j) Carrier's performance under this Agreement shall be evaluated as designated by the Customer's representative and may be modified from time to time during the term hereof.
  - k) There shall be no charge assessed by Carrier for any costs or expenses involved in arranging or fulfilling an appointment with respect to pick up and delivery services to consignee or consignor.
  - l) The term "pick up" as used herein, means the service performed by Carrier, or its agent, in calling for freight at Exel Inc.'s door or dock. Customer's employees will load the freight.
  - m) The term "delivery" as used herein means the service performed by Carrier or its agent in transporting freight to consignee's door or job site.

## 4. RECEIPTS AND BILLS OF LADING

Customer shall issue and Carrier shall sign freight receipts for each shipment in the form acceptable to Customer and the Shipper. If a bill of lading is used as a freight receipt, any terms, conditions or provisions thereof shall be subject and subordinate to the terms of this Agreement and, in the event of a conflict, this Agreement shall govern. Carrier's or Carrier's agent signature on the receipt or bill of lading shall be prima facie evidence that the Commodities were received in good condition unless otherwise noted on the face of such document. Upon delivery of each shipment, Carrier or Carrier's agent shall obtain a delivery receipt from the consignee(s), in form required by the Shipper, showing the Commodities delivered, their condition at time of delivery and the date and time of delivery.

## 5. DELIVERY ARRANGEMENTS; DELAYS; RECONSIGNMENT

- a) Unless otherwise directed by Customer, Carrier shall contact final consignee and all stop-off consignees included in a scheduled shipment to make arrangements, prior to Carrier accepting legal responsibility for the shipment, for appointments necessary to assure the timely delivery and unloading of Commodities. Carrier shall notify Customer of such appointments prior to Carrier moving the trailer from the pickup location.
- b) If Carrier encounters pickup or delivery problems that prevent the timely pickup or delivery of all or any part of a shipment, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer by telephone or facsimile for resolution and further instructions.
- c) Carrier shall not re-consign any shipment or any scheduled stop off delivery, without prior authorization from Customer, and the procedures of Exhibit A shall control with respect thereto.

- d) Refused or undelivered shipments and the Carriers' obligations for the same shall be as set forth in Exhibit A.

## 6. COMPENSATION AND BILLING

- a) Commodities shall be transported in accordance with the rates, charges, and special services listed in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto. Amendments to Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto shall be reduced to writing, signed by both parties and become effective upon the date noted in said Amendment.
- b) Carrier acknowledges that the rates, charges and special services in Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto are reasonable for the providing of the Services upon the terms and conditions of this Agreement. Changes to the rates, charges and special services shall be pursuant to amendments to Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto. If Carrier desires to propose a change to the rates, charges and special services, it shall provide Customer at least 60 days prior written notice.
- c) Except as otherwise provided herein, the rates, charges and special services set forth in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto (and/or an effective amendment thereto) shall be the sole rates, charges and special services which Customer will pay Carrier. These rates, charges and special services will supersede any other previous rates, charges and special services that may have been in effect between the parties prior to the date hereof. However, the parties intend by this Agreement to ratify, to the fullest extent permitted by law, all acts performed by either of them pursuant to any prior contract between them which purported to be a contract Broker agreement. If Carrier believes that Customer has requested it to perform any services outside the scope of this Agreement or the Exhibits and the Schedules thereto for which Carrier seeks additional compensation or accessorial charges, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer thereof by telephone or facsimile for resolution of such issue and a response as to whether additional compensation or accessorial charges shall be paid or reimbursed, which response shall be confirmed in writing. No additional or accessorial charges shall be assessed or paid without the prior approval of Customer.
- d) Carrier shall be paid within thirty (30) days of receipt by Customer, or its designee, of a correct invoice consisting of the original freight bill, in duplicate, or certified original copies and a master bill of lading. Such original freight bill must be presented to Customer within one hundred and eighty (180) days from the date of shipment. Absent an original freight bill within this allotted time all transportation charges due on any such shipment shall be cancelled by Carrier. Carrier shall also submit any documentation and/or supporting material as may be required by Customer. Carrier will submit copies of unloading/lumping receipts, Com-checks/T-checks and the like for driver unloads and bills of lading with original Carrier invoice. Carrier agrees to keep full, complete, and accurate records of Commodities moved and to maintain signed receipts for pick-up and delivery, to be provided to Customer to support Carrier's billing if requested by Customer. Carrier agrees to look exclusively to Customer for payment and expressly waives any claim it may have for unpaid rates or charges against Shipper or consignee. Carrier agrees that no penalties or interest will be assessed to Customer for past due amounts.
- e) No changes to this Agreement, Exhibits or Schedules (including by reason of fuel surcharges, interest charges, penalty provisions provided for by statute or regulation, and rate changes resulting from application of general increases to common Carrier tariff rates) shall be applicable or made without the express prior written consent of Customer and Carrier.
- f) The provisions of 49 CFR Part 378, as amended, entitled "Procedures Governing the Processing, Investigation and Disposition of Overcharges, Duplicate Payment, or Over collection Claims", shall apply as a process of resolving overcharge or duplicate payment claims thereunder.

## **7. LIMITATION ON ACTIONS FOR CHARGES AND FEES**

- a) If Carrier seeks to collect additional charges or if Customer seeks to contest charges originally billed or additional charges subsequently billed, Carrier must issue a bill for such additional charges within 180 days of the original bill and Customer must contest the original or additional charges within 180 days of its receipt of the bill for the same. If either party, after compliance with the first sentence hereof, desires to bring an action at law against the other party to recover undercharges or overcharges, the action shall be commenced not more than 18 months from delivery or tender of delivery by Carrier. Failure to commence an action within this period shall constitute full and final acknowledgement and acceptance of payment of all charges.
- b) In the event an action is initiated, the prevailing party's reasonable attorney's fees, costs and expenses shall be paid by the non-prevailing party.

## **8. INDEMNIFICATION**

Carrier and Carrier's agents shall indemnify, defend and hold Customer harmless from all losses, damages, expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees), actions and claims for injury or death to persons and damage to property (including the property of Customer or its employees but excluding the Commodities) asserted against Customer by any person (including, without limitation, Carrier's and Carrier's agents and Customer's employees) arising out of or resulting from the performance of the Services by Carrier or its agents and underlying carriers, or employees except to the extent (but only to the extent) caused by the negligence of Customer, its agents or employees.

## **9. LIABILITIES AND CLAIMS FOR COMMODITIES**

- a) Carrier shall be liable to Customer for loss, damage or injury to the Commodities tendered to Carrier for transportation hereunder while the Commodities are in its, its agent or underlying carrier's custody, possession or control except to the extent (and only to the extent) such loss, damage or injury results from (i) acts of God, the public enemy or public authority, (ii) inherent vice or nature of the Commodities, or (iii) the negligent acts of Customer or Shipper.
- b) The measurement of the loss, damage or injury to Commodities shall be the Shipper's replacement value applicable to the kind and quantity of Commodities so lost, damaged or destroyed. Customer shall deduct from the invoice price the reasonable salvage value of any damaged or injured Commodities not released to Carrier. Carrier acknowledges that some of the Commodities may be disposed of in a manner that will prevent the damaged goods from being sold on the open market.
- c) Carrier's liability on any claim for alleged loss, damage or delay (a "Claim"), and the procedures involved in processing any such Claim, shall be governed by 49 C.F.R. Part 370. ~~Carrier acknowledges that it assumes liability to Customer and shall indemnify and hold Customer harmless from any liability Customer may incur because of delays in delivering the Commodities.~~
- d) If any Commodities are lost, damaged or injured, Customer and/or Shipper or consignee ~~must submit a detailed Claim in writing within nine (9) months of date of delivery; and~~ Carrier shall settle or disallow such Claim within sixty (60) days of date of receipt of a Claim.
- e) The time limit for instituting suit against the Carrier shall be two (2) years and a day from the date on which the person filing a Claim (whether Customer or Shipper or consignee) receives a valid written disallowance from Carrier.
- f) A letter of disallowance from Carrier must state a lawful reason for declining to accept liability on the Claim.

## **10. INSURANCE**

Carrier, except as otherwise provided in Exhibit A, shall procure and maintain in force, at its own cost and expense, the following insurance with respect to the Services:

- a) Commercial General Liability, including the standard Insurance Service Office Broad Form Endorsement, with not less than a \$1,000,000.00 combined single limit for bodily injury or death to persons and property damage on an occurrence form, naming Exel Inc. as a certificate holder;
- b) Automobile Liability Insurance covering all owned, leased, hired or borrowed vehicles and employers non-owned liability with not less than a \$1,000,000.00 combined single limit for bodily injury or death to persons and property damage on an occurrence form, naming Exel Inc. as a certificate holder;
- c) Statutory Worker's Compensation Insurance with an employer's liability limit of \$250,000.00 or in state and federal statutory amounts, whichever is greater;
- d) Cargo Insurance coverage in an amount ~~not less than~~ \$100,000 per vehicle; *MS 97*
- e) Any additional insurance coverage or any increases in any of the foregoing amounts as required by applicable Federal or state law, rule or regulation or by the US Department of Transportation ("D.O.T") or as Exel Inc. may from time to time reasonably require.

The insurance required under this Section 10 does not limit Carrier's liability under the provisions of Sections 8 and 9.

The insurance policies under a), b) and d), above, shall contain by endorsements or otherwise that the coverage thereunder shall not terminate if Carrier becomes insolvent or bankrupt.
